_comment: Ground truth for the synthetic evaluation set, graded 0-4 against
JD/ai_ml_engineer_jd.txt. Grades are relevance tiers, not scores: the
pipeline is judged on whether it ORDERS candidates correctly, never on
whether it reproduces a particular number.
4 perfect  every required skill demonstrated, most preferred, right level
3 close    same shape as the target profile, one or two real gaps
2 good     strong engineer missing a meaningful chunk of the requirements
Labels were assigned when the resumes were written, before any run, so
they are not fitted to the pipeline's output.
Candidates not listed here are scored by the pipeline but excluded from
the metrics and reported separately -- a real resume has no ground truth.
